title: fix(plugin-grid,types): six of the eight keys ObjectGridSchema declares take effect or are retired (objectui#11068)
body:
Part of #11068
Clause-②: yes

This PR handles six of the eight keys, first key group: two are now honoured and four are retired. `showFilters` and `keyboardNavigation` are still declared and still unread. Neither has machinery in `ObjectGrid` to relay to (see "Premises measured"), so they go to a second PR. #11068 remains open for them.

## What changed, key by key

| Key | Disposition | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | **honoured** | One muted line of help text above the grid, drawn the same way `ListView` draws a view description (`view-description`). A locale map resolves against the display locale, the same way `label` does. A map with no usable entry draws nothing. It is drawn in the table, split-pane and card-view branches. |
| `emptyState` | **honoured** | Drawn in place of an empty table (flat, or grouped with no group) through `DataEmptyState` + `resolveIcon`, the same component and resolver `ListView` uses. If a member is left out, the grid falls back to the shared glyph, the table's own "No results found" heading, and no message. It is **not** drawn when a term in the grid's own server-side search box caused the empty result, so the table and its search box stay. It is text only, matching the table's empty row, which has no add-record row either. The zod twin now mirrors it as a strict object of three optional strings, so the `UnmirroredDeclared` ledger shrinks. |
| `rowSpecActions` | **retired** | `?: never` plus a named `retirementTombstone`. This was a second spelling of `rowActions`, which the grid reads and the upstream `object-grid` row declares. Nothing ever read `rowSpecActions`. |
| `bulkSpecActions` | **retired** | Same treatment, as a second spelling of `bulkActions`. |
| `name` | **retired on `object-grid`** | `?: never` narrows `BaseSchema.name`, following the `children?: never` precedent. A grid is not a form field. Identity is `id`, which also scopes the saved column layout (`grid-columns-OBJECT-ID`). The caption is `label`. |
| `placeholder` | **retired on `object-grid`** | A grid is not an input. The text shown for "no rows" is `emptyState.message`. |
| `showFilters`, `keyboardNavigation` | unchanged | Second PR. |

The `object-view` `table` slot still withholds all eight keys, as the ruling requires, so this PR does not widen that slot. The slot's zod refusal for `emptyState` / `description` used to say "`ObjectGrid` has no read of it". That is no longer true, so the refusal now says the grid honours the key on its own node and the view does not pass it on. The TypeScript docblock and the slot pin's reason groups (`unread` / `notRelayed`) were updated to match.

`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`: the `ObjectGridSchema` example now uses only keys the grid reads. Before this PR the example did not validate at all. `@object-ui/types`' zod `ObjectGridSchema` refused `selection: { enabled, mode }` and `pagination.enabled` (`unrecognized_keys`), and the example also used `showFilters`, `striped` and `operations.read`, which nothing reads. The example now parses green on the objectui face. `title` stays, because objectui#6639's ruling cites this example as one of the two confirmed authored `object-grid.title` nodes. The property table gained `description` / `emptyState` and a note on the four retired keys. The plugin-grid docs page and README document the same.

The pending changeset `.changeset/10976-table-slot-relay.md` said "no read in `ObjectGrid`: `emptyState`, …, `description`". This PR makes that false, which `check:changeset-claims` reported. The bullet is now split so both entries publish consistent text when they release together.

## Premises measured (objectui `origin/main` `76e9df06c`)

- The card's reading holds: none of the eight keys had a `schema.KEY` read in `ObjectGrid.tsx`. For the four retired keys, a byte ruler (below) confirms the renderer draws nothing.
- The upstream `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 `ObjectGridPropsSchema` is a `strictObject` that declares **none** of the eight keys, so the spec row does not carry any of the four retired keys. It declares `rowActions` / `bulkActions` / `batchActions`, which is where the retired second spellings point. Its own docblock says the key set is "derived from the objectui renderers' own read points". The objectui zod face now accepts the new example, and upstream still refuses `description` / `emptyState` (`unrecognized_keys`). See Acceptance notes.
- Dispatch Zone 2 #2 was **partly falsified**. `ObjectGrid` has no filter bar and no user-filter UI; filtering lives in `ListView`'s toolbar. `WidgetEmptyState` belongs to `plugin-dashboard`, not the grid. The table's own empty row (`data-table`) takes no title, message or icon. `data-table` has no arrow-key cell navigation, only native Tab focus (`tabIndex=0`), Enter-to-edit and Ctrl+C. So `description` / `emptyState` relay to `ListView`'s existing pattern, while `showFilters` / `keyboardNavigation` would need machinery that does not exist yet.

## Contract (Clause-②: yes)

Retiring four keys narrows the accepted set on both faces of `@object-ui/types` (`minor`, with the breaking effect described in the changeset). TypeScript that writes one of them no longer compiles, and a document carrying one fails validation with a named message that says what to write instead. No in-repo producer writes any of the four on an `object-grid` node. Measured: typed `ObjectGridSchema` literals in `plugin-designer` (`ObjectManager`, `FieldDesigner`) and `plugin-view` (`gridSchema`), plus every `object-grid` node literal under `packages`, `apps`, `examples`, `content` and `skills`.

## Verification (final head `62a502083`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: **282 files / 6491 tests passed** (types sources identical at head).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/`: **170 files / 1579 tests passed** (run on `dd52821ca`; head differs only by an eslint annotation comment in `ObjectGrid.tsx`).
- At head: the two new pins, `ObjectGrid.operatorsInert-9729`, `gridNonAuthorKeys`, `object-view-slot-key-lists`, `zod-mirror-parity`, `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView.tableSlotRelay-10976`, and the console's `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, `public-contract` and `i18nLabelInputsManifest-10993`: **10 files / 421 tests passed**. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0 after building the dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...'`, 13/13 tasks).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (all three legs, incl. `tsconfig.test.json`, which compiles the `@ts-expect-error` assertions): exit 0.
- **Ablations**, all run through `ablation-replace.mjs` on committed code; each restore was proven (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - `rowSpecActions?: never` → `string[]`: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2, with `TS2578 Unused '@ts-expect-error'` on the new pin and `TS2322` on the parity ratchet.
  - `emptyState` read disabled: 3 of 15 renderer-pin tests red (draws / defaults / host no-term control).
  - `description` read disabled: 3 red (string / locale map / the byte ruler's lit control).
  - The search guard `!searchEmptiedRows` removed: 1 red (the "search emptied it" case).
- eslint on the eight changed source and test files: 0 errors. Per-file warning counts are unchanged from the base (`ObjectGrid.tsx` 207/207, `objectql.ts` 34/34, `objectql.zod.ts` 1/1, the rest 0).
- Gates, exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `changeset:check`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; the one falsified claim was repaired as described above), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `docs:check-links`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:test-path-roots`. The governed-queue guard reports NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`, reason: prerequisite not met. It exits 1 because 369 self-imports across packages cannot be judged without built `dist/`; the added README block imports nothing. Also NOT MEASURED: type-check of the downstream importers of `ObjectGridSchema` (`plugin-view`, `plugin-designer`, `app-shell`). This narrowing is declared; CI's `pnpm type-check` covers it, and the grep above found no writer of a retired key.

## Acceptance notes

- **Upstream follow-up, reported for the seat.** The spec's `object-grid` row does not declare `description` / `emptyState`, even though `ObjectGrid` now reads both. Until it does, `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` cannot publish them, because the console's registry/spec parity gate forbids declaring a key the spec refuses. As a result, the SDUI parser reports an authored `emptyState` as `unknown-prop` (a warning). `description` is a base prop and is accepted. When the spec adds them, that gate's REVERSE direction will require the inputs to follow. This PR does not touch `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`.
- The SDUI parser still accepts `name` / `placeholder` on `object-grid` as `where-undeclared` base props, while both `@object-ui/types` faces now refuse them. The parser tier does not consult per-type tombstones. This is the cost objectui#11044 accepted for that list, and it is not changed here.
- The spec's `list-view` `emptyState` types `title` / `message` as `I18nLabel`. objectui declares plain `string` on both `ObjectGridSchema` and `ListViewSchema`. That narrowing is audible (tsc refuses a map) and is left as is.
- `showFilters` / `keyboardNavigation`: see the open questions in the dev report on #11068.
